newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber ends up ahead of housing report.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber ends up ahead of housing report.

text.p: Short covering ahead of Tuesday's U.S. housing starts report kept nearby CME lumber futures supported in light dealings, traders said.
Lumber closed up $4.00 per tbf to off $7.90 with September up most at $351.10 and November up $0.20 at $347.80 per tbf.

Nearbys were supported from the start on short covering with some buy stops adding to the early advance. Expectations of a small increase in July housing starts and covering after recent losses prompted the support, traders said.
The discount of futures to cash also prompted some support despite a weak undertone to the cash market, they added.
